50.evidenceText: From the 5 provided sources, two are specifically Clik Valve technical/FAQ pages: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve - "Bike Tire Valves | Schwalbe" - FAQ page specifically about valves and Clik Valve technology; (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve - "Schwalbe Clik Valve" - dedicated product/technical page.
